### Overall Assessment

Exceptional security review that found all 5 critical issues and most high-severity findings. The Jinx persona is brilliantly executed - chaotic, memorable, and genuinely makes the security findings more engaging without sacrificing technical accuracy. Minor gaps include missing some medium/low severity items (S3 versioning, final snapshot, encryption on S3, MySQL version, instance sizing), but the response prioritized the most impactful security issues effectively. The code snippets and remediation suggestions are practical and actionable.
